name: Migite ga Tomaranai Boku to, Osananajimi no Shimai
original_name: 右手がとまらない僕と、幼なじみの姉妹
source:
Kazu is the captain of the student council and good at basketball. He is also smart, so every student and teacher respects him. Next to his house, his childhood friends, Kokono and Miyabi, live. They are sisters and pretty. They all think that their peaceful life will last forever, but...

[From ErogeShop]
